recent_reviews.author: Kevin R.
recent_reviews.text: Good coffee but they were closed when Google said they'd be open. Hours need updating.

recent_reviews.author: Priya S.
recent_reviews.text: Nice little place with a great latte. Not many seats though.

proposal.description: Neighborhood coffee shop on Mill Street since 2019. Single-origin espresso and pour-over roasted in small batches, fresh almond croissants every morning, and a quiet corner to work. Oat and almond milk at no extra cost.

posts.text: New autumn menu: maple oat latte and pumpkin loaf, all week long.
Now open Sundays, 8 AM to 2 PM. See you this weekend!

illustrative_reviews.author: Jessica M.
illustrative_reviews.text: Best flat white in Riverton, and the almond croissants are always fresh. They remembered my order on my second visit. Lovely spot to work for an hour.
illustrative_reviews.owner_reply: Thanks Jessica! Glad the croissants passed the test. See you for the next flat white. Dana, owner

illustrative_reviews.author: Marcus T.
illustrative_reviews.text: Friendly baristas and a great single-origin pour-over. Gets busy on Saturday mornings but worth the short wait.
illustrative_reviews.owner_reply: Thank you Marcus! Saturdays are our favorite kind of busy. Try the new Ethiopian pour-over next time. Dana

update_ideas: Week 1: Autumn menu launch with the maple oat latte
Week 3: Meet the roaster, our beans this month

sample_review_reply.review_excerpt: Good coffee but they were closed when Google said they'd be open. Hours need updating.
sample_review_reply.reply: Thanks for the heads-up, and sorry about the wasted trip. Our hours are now correct on Google, including Sundays. Next coffee's on us if you mention this review. Dana, owner
